research_notes: Blocked for public/private headline years: nonpolitical dry-cleaning and financial-planning work has no usable dates/FTE. Official, member, employer and public professional sources checked.
The profile's volunteer dates improve the timeline but are excluded. No gated employment section was accessed.

Some narrative biographies place union work before the adviser role; official dated intervals are preferred without inventing a separate early SDA spell. Need employer/CV evidence for unresolved early work.
Follow-up2026-10-02: historical2014/2017/2019 employer reports recover exact vice-chair period, committee chair role and independent board resignation evidence. Finance employer remains unnamed.

Own first speech reviewed: represented7-Eleven workers; did not claim employment at7-Eleven. Father/grandfather manufacturing careers not imported.2020 local interview names Debonaires as current dry-cleaning supplier, not teenage employer. Italian municipal/accountancy namesakes rejected.

Next leads: finance employer or public CV, university/Collins/financial-work sequence and working hours; identify teenage dry cleaner. Keep historical governance control unknown pending constitution/appointment powers; public funding alone insufficient. All headline values remain null.

Third follow-up3October2026: targeted searches under Raff and Raffaele for the financial-planning employer, adviser sequence and teenage dry cleaner produced no reliable employer name, dates or hours. The current first-person member biography narrates SDA work before the Collins adviser role, while APH gives adviser2008–2013 then SDA2013–2019 and the2020 local interview places financial planning after graduation; the conflict is preserved rather than reordered. No new appointment, full-time or governance-control evidence was found; nonmaterial follow-up recorded and headline totals remain null.
